name: Mimporto Traffic Analytics
author: Domenico Porto

sections.description:
Mimporto Traffic Analytics is a lightweight and privacy-aware analytics plugin for WordPress.

Track real visitors directly inside your WordPress dashboard without relying on external services or heavy tracking platforms.

Designed to be simple, fast and privacy-friendly, the plugin stores analytics data locally inside your WordPress database and provides realtime traffic insights with minimal performance impact.

Version 2.0 introduces a multilingual admin interface with support for English, Italian, Spanish, French and German.

Features include:

  • Realtime visitors dashboard
  • Visitors history and page statistics
  • Active pages monitoring
  • Browser, device and referrer statistics
  • Privacy-friendly local data storage
  • Anti-bot filtering
  • Logged-in users exclusion
  • Do Not Track (DNT) support
  • Automatic email reports
  • Lightweight database usage
  • No external analytics services
  • No tracking cookies required
  • Multilingual admin interface
  • Localized date and time formats
  • Localized visitor and referrer labels
  • Mobile-friendly statistics tables

Perfect for website owners looking for a lightweight alternative to external analytics platforms.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mimporto-traffic-analytics directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Statistics menu to start monitoring your traffic.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use external analytics services?

No. All statistics are stored locally inside your WordPress database.

Does this plugin use cookies?

No tracking cookies are required.

Can I exclude administrators or specific IPs?

Yes. Logged-in users and IP addresses can be excluded from tracking.

Is the plugin GDPR friendly?

The plugin is designed with privacy in mind and stores data locally without external tracking services.

Which languages are supported?

The admin interface currently supports:

  • English
  • Italian
  • Spanish
  • French
  • German
